C. I. D.
I. O. REG
449
15/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

July 15th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang has instructed General Yang to inform Admiral Lee that he must leave Kiangsu province or cancel his independence.
Steps are being taken in the City to revive the Volunteer Corps which was disbanded in 1913.
It is reported that a general amnesty will soon be granted to political offenders. All warrants against political offenders will be withdrawn.
The Director of the Arsenal has sent a telegram to Peking saying he is in urgent need of funds.
It is reported that Dr. Sun Yat Sen, Tang Shao Yi, Huang Hsin, Li Ping Shu 李平書, Pah Vung Wei 柏文蔚, Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕永建, Won Chung Yao 溫宗堯, Wu Ting Fang, and several prominent parliamentarians met in the International Institute, Frenchtown at 2 p.m. yesterday. Several short speeches were made, and a general exchange of views on the measures necessary to deal with the situation took place. Dr. Gilbert Reid attended and talked with those present, but made no speech.
Two men named Sung Hyien Zah 宋教仁 and Sung Hyuin Sz 宋漢章 have come here to conduct the M.P.s to Peking.

（批：12/7 Civ.）

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
（签名）

刑事调查处
情报官登记
449
16/7/15

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年7月15日。

先生，
据报，冯国璋已指示杨将军告知李督军，他必须离开江苏省，否则取消独立。
市内正采取措施恢复于1913年解散的万国商团。
据报，即将对政治犯实行大赦。所有针对政治犯的逮捕令将被撤销。
兵工厂总监已向北京发送电报，称其急需资金。
据报，孙中山博士、唐绍仪、黄兴、李平書、柏文蔚、鈕永建、溫宗堯、伍廷芳以及几位著名议员于昨日下午2时在法租界国际学会集会。数人作了简短发言，并就应对局势所需措施交换了普遍意见。季理斐博士出席并与在场人士交谈，但未发表演讲。
两名分别名为宋教仁和宋漢章的人士已抵达此处，旨在护送国会议员前往北京。

（批注：7月12日 民事）

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警察总监
（签名）
